verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ יְדִיתוּן מִזְמֽוֹר׃ לְאָסָ֥ף קוֹלִ֣י אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶצְעָ֑קָה קוֹלִ֥י אֶל־ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וְהַאֲזִ֥ין אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- yə·ḏī·ṯūn miz·mō·wr lə·’ā·sāp̄ qō·w·lî ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’eṣ·‘ā·qāh qō·w·lî ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ha·’ă·zîn ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Jeduthun A Psalm of Asaph I cried out to God I cried aloud . . . to God to hear me

verses.original: בְּי֥וֹם צָרָתִי֮ דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי אֲדֹנָ֪י לַ֣יְלָה יָדִ֤י׀ נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג נַפְשִֽׁי׃ מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm ṣā·rā·ṯî dā·rā·šə·tî ’ă·ḏō·nāy lay·lāh yā·ḏî nig·gə·rāh wə·lō ṯā·p̄ūḡ nap̄·šî mê·’ă·nāh hin·nā·ḥêm
verses.literal: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord through the night my outstretched hands . . . - did not grow weary my soul refused to be comforted

verses.original: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶֽהֱמָיָ֑ה אָשִׂ֓יחָה׀ רוּחִ֣י וְתִתְעַטֵּ֖ף סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ez·kə·rāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’e·hĕ·mā·yāh ’ā·śî·ḥāh rū·ḥî wə·ṯiṯ·‘aṭ·ṭêp̄ se·lāh
verses.literal: I remembered You O God and I groaned I mused [and] my spirit grew faint Selah

verses.original: אָ֭חַזְתָּ עֵינָ֑י שְׁמֻר֣וֹת נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥaz·tā ‘ê·nāy šə·mu·rō·wṯ nip̄·‘am·tî wə·lō ’ă·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: You have kept my eyes from closing I am too troubled . . . to speak

verses.original: חִשַּׁ֣בְתִּי יָמִ֣ים מִקֶּ֑דֶם שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת עוֹלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḥiš·šaḇ·tî yā·mîm miq·qe·ḏem šə·nôt̲ ‘ō·w·lā·mîm
verses.literal: I considered the days of old the years long in the past

verses.original: בַּ֫לָּ֥יְלָה אֶֽזְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗י עִם־ לְבָבִ֥י אָשִׂ֑יחָה רוּחִֽי׃ וַיְחַפֵּ֥שׂ
verses.transliteration: bal·lā·yə·lāh ’ez·kə·rāh nə·ḡî·nā·ṯî ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇî ’ā·śî·ḥāh rū·ḥî way·ḥap·pêś
verses.literal: At night I remembered my song in my heart I mused [and] my spirit pondered

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֑י יִזְנַ֥ח׀ הַֽ֭לְעוֹלָמִים וְלֹֽא־ יֹסִ֖יף עֽוֹד׃ לִרְצ֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy yiz·naḥ hal·‘ō·w·lā·mîm wə·lō- yō·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ lir·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Will the Lord spurn [us] forever and never . . . . . . show His favor again

verses.original: חַסְדּ֑וֹ הֶאָפֵ֣ס לָנֶ֣צַח אֹ֝֗מֶר גָּ֥מַר לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥas·dōw he·’ā·p̄ês lā·ne·ṣaḥ ’ō·mer gā·mar lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: Is His loving devotion gone forever Has His promise failed for all time . . .

verses.original: אֵ֑ל אִם־ הֲשָׁכַ֣ח חַנּ֣וֹת בְּ֝אַ֗ף קָפַ֥ץ רַחֲמָ֥יו סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl ’im- hă·šā·ḵaḥ ḥan·nō·wṯ bə·’ap̄ qā·p̄aṣ ra·ḥă·māw se·lāh
verses.literal: Has God . . . forgotten to be gracious Has His anger shut off His compassion Selah

verses.original: וָ֭אֹמַר חַלּ֣וֹתִי יְמִ֣ין עֶלְיֽוֹן׃ הִ֑יא שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ḥal·lō·w·ṯî yə·mîn ‘el·yō·wn hî šə·nôt̲
verses.literal: So I said I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed . . .

verses.original: אַזְכִּיר מַֽעַלְלֵי־ יָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ אֶזְכְּרָ֖ה פִּלְאֶֽךָ׃ מִקֶּ֣דֶם
verses.transliteration: ʾaz·kīr ma·‘al·lê- yāh kî- ’ez·kə·rāh pil·’e·ḵā miq·qe·ḏem
verses.literal: I will remember the works of the LORD yes I will remember Your wonders of old

verses.original: וְהָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־ פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃ וּֽבַעֲלִ֖ילוֹתֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·ḡî·ṯî ḇə·ḵāl- pā·‘o·le·ḵā ’ā·śî·ḥāh ū·ḇa·‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds

verses.original: דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ מִי־ אֵ֥ל גָּ֝ד֗וֹל כֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: dar·ke·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm baq·qō·ḏeš mî- ’êl gā·ḏō·wl kê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Your way O God is holy What god [is so] great as [our] God

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה הָ֭אֵל עֹ֣שֵׂה פֶ֑לֶא הוֹדַ֖עְתָּ עֻזֶּֽךָ׃ בָעַמִּ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh hā·’êl ‘ō·śêh p̄e·le hō·w·ḏa‘·tā ‘uz·ze·ḵā ḇā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: You are the God who works wonders You display Your strength among the peoples

verses.original: בִּזְר֣וֹעַ גָּאַ֣לְתָּ עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּנֵי־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְיוֹסֵ֣ף סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: biz·rō·w·a‘ gā·’al·tā ‘am·me·ḵā bə·nê- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yō·w·sêp̄ se·lāh
verses.literal: With power You redeemed Your people the sons of Jacob and Joseph Selah

verses.original: מַּ֨יִם׀ רָ֘א֤וּךָ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים מַּ֣יִם רָא֣וּךָ יָחִ֑ילוּ אַ֝֗ף תְהֹמֽוֹת׃ יִרְגְּז֥וּ
verses.transliteration: ma·yim rā·’ū·ḵā ’ĕlō·hîm ma·yim rā·’ū·ḵā yā·ḥî·lū ’ap̄ ṯə·hō·mō·wṯ yir·gə·zū
verses.literal: The waters saw You O God the waters saw You and swirled even the depths were shaken

verses.original: עָב֗וֹת זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם׀ שְׁחָקִ֑ים נָתְנ֣וּ ק֭וֹל אַף־ חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇō·wṯ zō·rə·mū ma·yim šə·ḥā·qîm nā·ṯə·nū qō·wl ’ap̄- ḥă·ṣā·ṣe·ḵā yiṯ·hal·lā·ḵū
verses.literal: The clouds poured down water the skies resounded with thunder - Your arrows flashed back and forth

verses.original: רַעַמְךָ֨׀ ק֤וֹל בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל בְרָקִ֣ים הֵאִ֣ירוּ תֵּבֵ֑ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃ רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ
verses.transliteration: ra·‘am·ḵā qō·wl bag·gal·gal ḇə·rā·qîm hê·’î·rū tê·ḇêl hā·’ā·reṣ rā·ḡə·zāh wat·tir·‘aš
verses.literal: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind the lightning lit up the world the earth trembled and quaked

verses.original: דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ בַּיָּ֤ם וּשְׁבִילֶיךָ רַבִּ֑ים בְּמַ֣יִם וְ֝עִקְּבוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: dar·ke·ḵā bay·yām ū·šə·ḇī·lɛ·ḵå̄ rab·bîm bə·ma·yim wə·‘iq·qə·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā lō nō·ḏā·‘ū
verses.literal: Your path led through the sea Your way through the mighty waters but Your footprints were not to be found

verses.original: נָחִ֣יתָ עַמֶּ֑ךָ כַצֹּ֣אן בְּֽיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḥî·ṯā ‘am·me·ḵā ḵaṣ·ṣōn bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron
